meta.title: WeizChat — the shared WhatsApp inbox with an AI sales agent
meta.description: One team inbox for business WhatsApp, an AI agent that quotes real catalog prices, chatbot and automation — on Meta's official Cloud API.

hero.title: No WhatsApp customer left waiting.
hero.sub: WeizChat is a shared WhatsApp inbox for your whole team, with Weizic — an AI agent that answers instantly, quotes real prices from your catalog, and hands over to a human whenever needed.
hero.imageAlt: The real WeizChat inbox: a team conversation list and an open WhatsApp chat with the customer panel.

problem.title: Business WhatsApp without a system is chaos.

scattered.title: Scattered conversations
scattered.body: Customers write to employees' personal phones — the business never sees the conversation.

noHistory.title: No ownership, no history
noHistory.body: When an agent leaves, their chats, contacts and open deals leave with them.

waiting.title: Customers wait for hours
waiting.body: By the time someone answers, the customer has already bought somewhere else.

inbox.title: Shared team inbox
inbox.body: Every conversation in one place — assignments, statuses and internal notes. Each agent sees exactly what they need.

ai.title: AI sales agent
ai.body: Weizic answers instantly, identifies products, quotes real catalog prices — and knows when to hand over to a person.

bot.title: Chatbot & automation
bot.body: After-hours replies, routing and lifecycle automations — without losing the human touch.

ai.title: From a photo to a quote — on its own.

photo.title: A customer sends a photo or serial
photo.body: A picture of a product, a model name or a serial number — the way customers actually write.

research.title: Weizic finds the exact model
research.body: The AI researches your own catalog to match the exact product.

answer.title: Real price, real stock
answer.body: The reply carries product, SKU, price and stock from your data. Weizic never invents a price.

escalate.title: Not sure? A human steps in
escalate.body: Low confidence or a sensitive request — the conversation escalates to your team with full context.

ai.honest: A human agent can take over any conversation, at any moment. Always.

platform.title: Built on the official platform
platform.body: WeizChat works with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) — no workarounds, no risk to your number.

cloudApi.title: Official Cloud API
cloudApi.body: The connection runs through Meta's official API, with a WhatsApp Business Account you own.

templates.title: Template messages
templates.body: Reaching out first happens with message templates approved by Meta in advance.

optIn.title: Opt-in first
optIn.body: Messages go only to customers who agreed to hear from you — WhatsApp policy, and good business.

greenTick.title: Verified business
greenTick.body: Businesses that meet Meta's criteria can apply for the official verified badge.

pricing.title: Conversation-based pricing
pricing.body: Meta bills per conversation, separately from your subscription. We explain exactly how it works.

service.label: Customer service
service.a: Every incoming question lands in one queue and is assigned to an available agent.
service.b: Weizic answers the routine ones — opening hours, order status, return policy.
service.c: Internal notes on every conversation, invisible to the customer.

sales.label: Sales
sales.a: A customer asks about a product — Weizic identifies it and quotes the catalog price.
sales.b: Complex deals escalate to a salesperson with the full conversation history.
sales.c: No lead disappears: every conversation is on the customer's card.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.a: Campaigns with approved templates, sent to audiences filtered by tags.
marketing.b: Honest measurement: sent, delivered, read, replied.
marketing.c: A campaign reply lands straight in the shared inbox as a live conversation.

crm.title: A simple CRM, already inside
crm.body: No extra system to buy: every customer gets a card with everything that matters.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.metaNote: On top of your subscription, Meta charges separately for conversations at its official rates. There are no hidden message fees from us.

waba.q: Do I need my own WhatsApp Business Account?
waba.a: Yes. You connect a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) that belongs to you — it stays yours, and we guide you through the setup.

charges.a: Meta bills conversation fees directly at its official rates. Your WeizChat subscription is separate and does not include Meta's charges.

keepNumber.q: Can I keep my existing number?
keepNumber.a: In most cases, yes. A number currently used in the WhatsApp app goes through a migration to the Business Platform — we walk you through it step by step.

data.a: Your data is isolated per organization, never sold, and deleted on request. The details are in our privacy policy and data deletion pages.

aiSafety.q: Can the AI say something wrong to my customers?
aiSafety.a: Weizic follows the rules and catalog you define, never invents a price, and asks or escalates when unsure. You can also switch it to draft-only mode, where a human approves every reply.

finalCta.title: See it answer on your own number.
finalCta.sub: Connect your WhatsApp Business Account and watch Weizic handle real conversations — with your team in control.
